basic_info.description: Welcome to 72 Townsendwhere historic character meets sleek city living, just one block from Oracle Park.  This stylish 1-bedroom, 1-bath condo maximizes space and light with its open floor plan, floor-to-ceiling windows, and clean modern finishes. You'll love the hardwood floors, Caesarstone countertops, custom Studio Becker cabinetry, and premium Bosch & Thermador appliances. A private balcony, generous pantry, in-unit washer/dryer, and 1-car parking make it as functional as it is beautiful.  Once a historic grain warehouse, 72 Townsend was transformed into a boutique 74-unit building in 2015. Residents enjoy standout amenities including a secure lobby with attendant, hospitality lounge, bike storage, and a shared rooftop deck with panoramic city views and BBQ areaperfect for gathering before or after the game.  Love baseball? You're just a short stroll to the stadium. Also nearby: Mission Bay, Chase Center, the Embarcadero, Ferry Building, Financial District, and top dining spots. Commuting is easy with Muni, Caltrain, BART, freeways, and the Bay Bridge all within reach.
